description: This file defines server-side handlers and utility functions for managing nodes in a gateway system, including node pairing, invocation, event handling, and push notification management via APNS.

classes.name: NodeWakeState
classes.description: Tracks the last wake time and in-flight wake attempt for a node.

classes.name: NodeWakeAttempt
classes.description: Represents the result of a wake attempt, including status and reason.

classes.name: NodeWakeNudgeAttempt
classes.description: Represents the result of a wake nudge attempt, including status and reason.

classes.name: PendingNodeAction
classes.description: Represents a queued action to be performed on a node, with metadata.

methods.name: resolveDirectNodePushConfig
methods.description: Resolves push configuration for direct APNS communication based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveRelayNodePushConfig
methods.description: Resolves relay push configuration for APNS based on environment variables.

methods.name: clearStaleApnsRegistrationIfNeeded
methods.description: Clears outdated APNS registration if deemed necessary based on result.

methods.name: isForegroundRestrictedIosCommand
methods.description: Checks if a command is restricted to foreground execution on iOS.

methods.name: shouldQueueAsPendingForegroundAction
methods.description: Determines if a command should be queued due to iOS background restrictions.

methods.name: prunePendingNodeActions
methods.description: Removes expired pending actions for a node.

methods.name: enqueuePendingNodeAction
methods.description: Adds a new pending action to the queue for a node.

methods.name: listPendingNodeActions
methods.description: Lists current pending actions for a node.

methods.name: resolveAllowedPendingNodeActions
methods.description: Filters pending actions based on command allowlist and client context.

methods.name: ackPendingNodeActions
methods.description: Acknowledges and removes specified pending actions for a node.

methods.name: toPendingParamsJSON
methods.description: Serializes parameters to JSON string for pending actions.

methods.name: maybeWakeNodeWithApns
methods.description: Attempts to wake a node via APNS, with throttling and fallback logic.

methods.name: maybeSendNodeWakeNudge
methods.description: Sends a wake nudge notification to a node if not throttled.

methods.name: waitForNodeReconnect
methods.description: Polls until a node reconnects or timeout occurs.

methods.name: buildNodeCommandRejectionHint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable hint for command rejection reasons.
